description: This file contains utility functions for generating metadata for web pages, including functions to create Open Graph images and page titles/descriptions based on localization and context.

methods.name: getTranslate
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the translation object for the current locale.

methods.name: _generateMetadataWithoutImage
methods.description: Generates page metadata including title, description, and Open Graph info without an image.

methods.name: _generateMetadata
methods.description: Generates page metadata with a generic Open Graph image.

methods.name: _generateMetadataForStaticPage
methods.description: Generates static page metadata with a specified title and description, including Open Graph info.

methods.name: generateMeetingMetadata
methods.description: Generates metadata for a meeting page, including a meeting-specific Open Graph image.

methods.name: generateAppMetadata
methods.description: Generates metadata for an app page, including an app-specific Open Graph image.
